zh: 新增 Pro 订阅：可在账户页升级，解锁更宽裕的每日 AI 额度与全部高阶模型
邮箱登录改为 App 内原生体验，并优化了 GitHub 登录流程
升级后需要手动重新登录一次：用原来的邮箱或 GitHub 账号登录即可，仍是同一个账号
README 详情页的「一键解读」移到了更顺手的位置
en: New Pro subscription: upgrade from your account page for a more generous daily AI allowance and all advanced models
Email sign-in is now a native in-app experience, and the GitHub sign-in flow has been improved
You'll need to sign in again after this update: use your original email or GitHub account and you'll land on the same account
"One-tap summary" moved to a more reachable spot on the README page
